checks.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- git identity ---' && git rev-parse HEAD && git status --short --branch && printf '%s\\n' '--- remotes ---' && git remote -v && printf '%s\\n' '--- worktree ---' && git diff --stat && git diff --name-only && printf '%s\\n' '--- instruction refs ---' && sed -n '1,240p' /Users/haewonkim/.codex/RTK.md && sed -n '1,260p' /Users/haewonkim/.codex/law.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main && printf '%s\\n' '--- refs ---' && rtk git show-ref --heads --dereference && printf '%s\\n' '--- manifest/release candidates ---' && rtk rg --files -g 'construction_manifest.json' -g '*release*' -g '*verify*' -g 'APP_PATTERNS.md' -g 'DESIGN_CONSTITUTION_V1_6.md' | sort | head -200"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- construction manifest ---' && rtk sed -n '1,260p' company_ui/ai/construction_manifest.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- release authority ---' && rtk sed -n '1,320p' company_ui/release_authority.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- release contract ---' && rtk sed -n '1,360p' company_ui/governance/release_contract.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- verifier ---' && rtk sed -n '1,420p' scripts/verify_release.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- app patterns ---' && rtk sed -n '1,220p' docs/APP_PATTERNS.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- native recovery references ---' && rtk rg -n -C 3 \"native-recovery|run_native_recovery|process|restart|cleanup|returncode|error\" scripts/release_checks/run_native_recovery.py scripts/release_checks scripts/verify_release.py | head -320 && printf '%s\\n' '--- verifier runtime prerequisites ---' && rtk rg -n \"nicegui|pytest|playwright|requirements\" pyproject.toml requirements.txt requirements-certification.txt setup.sh scripts/release_checks/run_native_recovery.py | head -220 && printf '%s\\n' '--- RTK ---' && rtk --version"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- report summary ---' && rtk jq '{release_status,checks_status,host_mode,required_gate_count:(.required_gates|length),required_gates,remaining_release_validation,git_status_at_start,source_editor_sha256,source_page_sha256}' /tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/report.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- all required gate statuses ---' && rtk jq -r '.required_gates[] as "'$g | (.checks[] | select(.name==$g) | "'"\\("'$g)'"\\t\\(.status)\\treturncode=\\(.returncode // \"NA\")\\terror=\\(.error // \"\")\\tlog=\\(.log // \"\")\")' /tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/report.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- source stability/frozen ---' && rtk jq '.checks[] | select(.name==\"source-stability\" or .name==\"frozen-connector\")' /tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/report.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- native recovery ---' && rtk jq '{status,passed,total,harness_error,unexpected_errors,expected_fault_events,cases}' /tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/native-recovery/native-recovery.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- progress tail ---' && rtk tail -80 /tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/progress.json"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git rev-parse HEAD
rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^{tree}
rtk git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main
rtk git status --porcelain=v1 --branch
rtk git diff --check
rtk git diff --name-only
rtk jq -c '"'.required_gates[] as "'$g | (.checks[] | select(.name==$g) | {name,status,returncode:(.returncode // null),error:(.error // null),log:(.log // null)})'"' /tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/report.json
rtk jq -c '.cases[] | {name,status,steps,error:(.error // null)}' /tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/native-recovery/native-recovery.json
rtk python -c 'import importlib.util,json; spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"vr\",\"scripts/verify_release.py\"); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod); recorded=json.loads(open(\"/tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/source-manifest.json\",encoding=\"utf-8\").read()); actual=mod.source_manifest(); print(json.dumps({\"source_manifest_equal\":actual==recorded,\"recorded_entries\":len(recorded),\"actual_entries\":len(actual),\"source_stability\":json.loads(open(\"/tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/report.json\",encoding=\"utf-8\").read())[\"checks\"][-2]}))'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk jq -r '.cases[] | [.name,.status,(.steps|join(\" -> \")),(.error // \"none\")] | @tsv' /tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/native-recovery/native-recovery.json
rtk jq -r '\"status=\\(.status) passed=\\(.passed)/\\(.total) harness_error=\\(.harness_error // \"none\") unexpected_errors=\\(.unexpected_errors|length)\"' /tmp/visembler-chg19-r2.h3TtNG/native-recovery/native-recovery.json
rtk git status --short
rtk git diff --check"
